hooks.prompt: A tool is about to access a file or folder. Check if the file path in TOOL_INPUT looks like it is inside an Obsidian vault (contains 'Obsidian', 'vault', or '.obsidian') or a cloud storage path (contains 'Google Drive', 'OneDrive', 'iCloud', 'Dropbox'). If it IS one of those locations, return {"decision": "ask_user", "reason": "This will {{action}} {{path}} in your vault/cloud storage. Allow?"}. Replace {{action}} with 'read from' for Read/Glob/Grep and 'write to' for Write/Edit. Replace {{path}} with the file or folder path from TOOL_INPUT. If the path is NOT a vault or cloud storage path, return {"decision": "approve"}.
